name: Name
help-center-text: Welcome to your financial command center! Whether you’re here to crush debt, save for a dream vacation, or just figure out where that extra $50 went last week, we’ve got you covered.
started1: Set up your prefferences, including theme, accent color, language or currency and more to personalize your experience.
started2: Manualy add transactions, including cash deposits, private loan payments, and investments, to keep track of your finances.
started3: Transaction History: Access a detailed history of your transactions, including cash deposits, private loan payments, and investments, filter and sort by date, category, or other criteria.
budget1: Create Limits of categories: Go to Budgets and Add limits. You can label them anything from 'Rent' to 'Emergency Guacamole Fund'.
budget2: edit and delete Limits and goals: Assign a dollar amount to each category. We’ll notify you when you’re approaching 80% of your limit or goal.
budget3: Budget History: Access a detailed history of your budget, including limits, goals, and actual spending.
analytics1: Dive deep into your spending: View a detailed report of your spending by month, category, or other criteria.
analytics2: Get all kinds of reports and charts based on selected time period.
analytics3: Go to dashboard to see most important overview of your finacial situation for selected period of time.
security1: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA): We highly recommend enabling 2FA in your Security Settings for an extra layer of protection.
security2: Password reset: in case you forget your password, you can request a password reset link via email.
security3: We will never ask for your password via email or text. Always ensure you are logged in through our secure portal.
faq1: How do I add a new transaction?
faq11: Go to transacctions page, look for add transaction section, fill the form and click 'Add Transaction'.
faq2: How do see information about budget?
faq22: You should first add transactions, then go to budget page. then add limits and goals for each category, and see it on budget overview.
faq3: Why are my financial reports not showing?
faq33: You probably havnt set any transactions yet or have not provided enough data to generate reports or have not provided period of time.
stillhelp1: Can't find what you're looking for? Our human support team (not bots!) is ready to jump in.
stillhelp3: Community Forum: Check out our user-led tips for advanced budgeting strategies and more.
chatText: Our support team is here to help you with any questions or issues you may have. Feel free to reach out to us!
overviewText: This calculations are based on your monthly category limits. Transactions that aren't in the categories that you have set budget for will not be included
secondText: All limits are based on your monthly category limits, so its recommended to set limits for all categories. You can inspect and delete them in this section.
plsGnrt: Please select a period to generate reports
analyticsTxt: This is the analytics page. Here you can view various metrics and insights about your finances. You can search for all the financial reports here. All of the reports are generated based on your transactions and the selected period.
nobudget: You have not set any budget yet.
nobudget2: Please go to Limits & goals section and set a budget to see the overview.
